_comment: Local Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode processes and their child work. No multiplexer or hooks required. Session guesses and source failures remain visible.
_refresh_comment: Seconds between local process and session-log reads. Settings changes and r request a fresh sample immediately.
_finished_per_agent_comment: Maximum latest finished log children to show per live parent process in its matched session. Set 0 for unfinished work only. This excludes older sessions and exited parent processes; it is not total finished-work history.
